name: NAF7_Short1_Ask_Allah_for_Good_Thoughts
title: Ask Allah for Good Thoughts | Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. #shorts
desc:
When a useless thought comes at the wrong time, ask Allah for that same thought in its positive form, and pray to be saved from bad thoughts. Allah has commanded: Ud'uni astajib lakum, ask of Me and I will give you; and du'a is the core of worship, the thing that completes it.

“O Master, take away these useless thoughts, and give us good thoughts.”

These practices bring their benefit after you take Bay'ah with a Shaykh or his Khalifa and follow their guidance.

name: NAF7_Short2_The_Pact_of_Remembrance
title: The Pact of Remembrance | Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. #shorts
desc:
The pact of yaad-faramosh: sitting together, one would call out “Allah!”; whoever's heart was present answered Alhamdulillah, and whoever had become heedless answered Astaghfirullah. It helps toward constant presence, makes one admit one's own mistake, and makes one's work lillah, fillah.

“The remembrance of Allah must go on; never forget.”

These practices bring their benefit after you take Bay'ah with a Shaykh or his Khalifa and follow their guidance.

name: NAF7_Short3_Stand_Up_and_the_Thought_Leaves
title: Stand Up and the Thought Leaves | Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. #shorts
desc:
Tried and tested methods for driving away khatrat: when stray thoughts come in great numbers, change your state, for the root principle is movement; run from the thought until it is left behind; or imagine, in the world of imagination, that the thought is running away from you.

“The moment we stand up and change our state, the khatrat vanish.”

These practices bring their benefit after you take Bay'ah with a Shaykh or his Khalifa and follow their guidance.

name: NAF7_Short4_Take_Refuge_in_Allah
title: Take Refuge in Allah | Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. #shorts
desc:
When khatrat keep coming, come into the refuge of Allah and ask Him to take them away. Hazrat also gives the fourth method, breathing out forcefully saying “hoon, hoon”, and the sixth, reciting the verse “If He wills, He will take you away and bring a new creation”. Even the Awliya Allah are troubled by khatrat, and they too come into Allah's refuge.

“If You leave us troubled, where else will we find refuge?”

These practices bring their benefit after you take Bay'ah with a Shaykh or his Khalifa and follow their guidance.

name: NAF7_Short5_I_Recognise_You_in_Every_Form
title: I Recognise You in Every Form | Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. #shorts
desc:
The fifth method belongs to the very great ones: when a khatra comes, they say, “You came in changing forms: so what? I certainly recognise you. The real existence is You.” Nothing has an existence of its own; existence is Allah's alone. Hazrat explains it with the rubai “Bad kaun hai aur nek hai kaun?”, and says it belongs to a very high station.

“In everything, whose is the existence? Allah's.”

These practices bring their benefit after you take Bay'ah with a Shaykh or his Khalifa and follow their guidance.
